challenges.title: Walk 6,000 steps
challenges.description: Spread your steps through the day. Every step counts.

challenges.title: Do 20 squats
challenges.description: Bodyweight squats, split into sets if you like. Go only as deep as feels comfortable.

challenges.title: Drink 8 glasses of water
challenges.description: Sip through the day and keep a bottle nearby.

challenges.title: Be active for 20 minutes
challenges.description: Walk, dance, cycle or play. Anything that gets you moving counts.

challenges.title: Stretch for 5 minutes
challenges.description: Gentle stretches for your neck, shoulders, back and legs.

challenges.title: Complete today's workout
challenges.description: Finish your planned workout from start to end.

challenges.title: Do 10 push-ups
challenges.description: Wall, knee or full push-ups all count. Pick the version that suits you.

challenges.title: Walk 8,000 steps
challenges.description: One good walk or a few short ones add up.

challenges.title: Take 3 movement breaks
challenges.description: Stand up and move for two minutes, three times today.

challenges.title: Walk after a meal
challenges.description: A relaxed 15-minute stroll after eating.

challenges.title: Do 15 lunges
challenges.description: Alternate legs and keep your steps slow and steady.

challenges.title: Start the day with water
challenges.description: Drink a glass of water soon after you wake up.

challenges.title: Walk 4,000 steps
challenges.description: A gentle target for a busy or slower day.

challenges.title: Do 30 jumping jacks
challenges.description: Prefer low impact? Step side to side with arm raises instead.

challenges.title: Be active for 30 minutes
challenges.description: Break it up however you like. Short bursts count too.

challenges.title: Take the stairs
challenges.description: Choose the stairs over the lift once today, if you can.

challenges.title: Walk 10,000 steps
challenges.description: A big one! Plan a longer walk to help you get there.

challenges.title: Do 20 glute bridges
challenges.description: Lie on your back, lift your hips, and squeeze at the top.

challenges.title: Breathe slowly for 2 minutes
challenges.description: Slow, deep breaths to reset your mind.

challenges.title: Dance to a favorite song
challenges.description: No rules. Just move to a track you love.

challenges.title: Do 10 minutes of yoga
challenges.description: Follow a video or flow on your own. Go gently.

challenges.title: Drink 6 glasses of water
challenges.description: A lighter hydration goal. Keep a bottle nearby.

challenges.title: Do 25 calf raises
challenges.description: Rise onto your toes slowly. Hold a wall for balance if you like.

challenges.title: Take a brisk 10-minute walk
challenges.description: Walk fast enough to feel your heart rate rise a little.

challenges.title: Do 15 wall push-ups
challenges.description: A friendly warm-up for your arms and chest.

challenges.title: Walk 5,000 steps
challenges.description: A steady middle-of-the-road goal for today.

challenges.title: Add veggies to 3 meals
challenges.description: Add a serving of vegetables to three meals or snacks today.

challenges.title: Screens off before bed
challenges.description: Put your phone away 30 minutes before bedtime.

challenges.title: Cool down after exercise
challenges.description: Finish a workout with a slow walk and a stretch.

challenges.title: Do 20 crunches
challenges.description: Or pick a gentler core move like dead bugs. Keep your neck relaxed.

challenges.title: Walk 7,000 steps
challenges.description: A short extra walk can close the gap on a typical day.

challenges.title: Try a new exercise
challenges.description: Pick any exercise you have never tried and give it a go.
